name: Growth & Optimization (SDLC Phase 13)
description: Driving product growth and optimization — aka Product-Led Growth, Growth Loops, Experimentation Framework, 1→N Stage.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Growth & Optimization
capabilities.description: Drives measurable product growth through analytics, structured experimentation, and retention optimization.

services.name: Product Analytics Specification
services.contractDescription: Funnel tracking, retention cohort specs, and product-led growth telemetry implementation.

services.name: Event Taxonomy & Tracking Plan
services.contractDescription: Segment / Mixpanel event naming conventions, property schemas, and privacy consent rules.

services.name: Experimentation Framework
services.contractDescription: A/B testing methodology, sample size calculator rules, and statistical significance criteria.

services.name: Growth Experiments Backlog
services.contractDescription: ICE / RICE prioritized growth experiment hypotheses targeting acquisition, activation, and referral loops.

services.name: Pricing & Packaging Tests
services.contractDescription: Tiered packaging experiments, Van Westendorp price sensitivity tests, and feature paywall triggers.

services.name: Retention & Engagement Dashboard
services.contractDescription: Daily, weekly, and monthly retention curves, churn prediction models, and power user curve analysis.

checklists.name: Growth & Optimization (SDLC Phase 13) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for product analytics, A/B experiment execution, and retention optimization.

items.statement: Each entry in the growth experiments backlog states a clear hypothesis and a measurable success metric before it is run.
Event tracking plan validation confirms zero missing properties across primary conversion funnels.
A/B test results meet minimum 95% statistical significance threshold before rollout to 100% of users.
Retention curves demonstrate a flattened tail indicating long-term product-market fit stability.
Pricing and packaging changes are vetted against customer churn impact and ARR projections.

reviewGates.name: Growth Optimization Review
reviewGates.statement: The Product Analytics Specification and experimentation results have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Internationalization & Localization.
reviewGates.prompt: Do the analytics specification and experiment results demonstrate sustainable growth, retention, and monetisation momentum?
